verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents first-party Python, TypeScript and REST integration for running tasks and multi-step automations, including structured extraction, sessions and artifacts, plus an official MCP server. That covers core task execution programmatically. However, nothing in the evidence claims API parity with the UI, and the UI-centric features (drag-and-drop workflow builder, browser recorder, SOP upload, Copilot chat, team template sharing) have no documented API equivalents. Probes also found no public OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage of workflow-builder/recorder/SOP/copilot/template features, and a published API reference or OpenAPI spec.
